title: Architecture-Aware Reinforcement Learning Makes Sliding-Window Attention Competitive in Math Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.11634v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid progress of reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs) has increased the demand for long-context inference, but self-attention (SA) scales quadratically with context length.   To address this, we study SWARR (Sliding-Window Attention with Reinforced Adaptation for Math Reasoning), a practical recipe for adapting SWA models to mathematical reasoning. SWARR has two stages: (1) efficient conversion from a pretrained SA model to SWA with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which avoids pretraining a new base model, and (2) policy adaptation with reinforcement learning (RL).   We find that SWA still underperforms SA after SFT, and we hypothesize that this gap is caused in part by a data-architecture mismatch: most SFT data are prepared for SA models and may contain long-range dependencies that are difficult for SWA to model. translated_title: 架构感知的强化学习使滑动窗口注意力在数学推理中具备竞争力
translated_abstract: 推理型与智能体式大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展增加了对长上下文推理的需求，但自注意力（SA）的计算开销随上下文长度呈二次方增长。为解决这一问题，我们研究了SWARR（面向数学推理的强化自适应滑动窗口注意力），这是一套将SWA模型适配到数学推理的实用方案。SWARR包含两个阶段：（1）通过监督微调（SFT）将预训练的SA模型高效转换为SWA模型，从而避免重新预训练新的基础模型；（2）通过强化学习（RL）进行策略适配。我们发现，经过SFT后SWA的性能仍不及SA，我们假设这一差距部分源于数据与架构的不匹配：大多数SFT数据是为SA模型准备的，可能包含SWA难以建模的长程依赖关系。由于on-policy强化学习在SWA约束下优化模型自生成的轨迹，它可以使轨迹适应（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出SWARR两阶段方法——先用监督微调将预训练自注意力模型高效转换为滑动窗口注意力模型，再用on-policy强化学习适配数据与架构的不匹配——使滑动窗口注意力在数学推理任务上具备与自注意力相当的竞争力，同时缓解长上下文推理的二次方计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SWARR, a two-stage recipe that first converts a pretrained self-attention model to sliding-window attention via supervised fine-tuning and then uses on-policy reinforcement learning to resolve the data-architecture mismatch, making SWA competitive with self-attention in math reasoning while reducing the quadratic cost of long-context inference.
